value.rationale: This is the natural coefficientwise exceptional-characteristic specialization of the classical Roman quartic. The intrinsic scheme captures three length-three wild defects invisible in the reduced double-line configuration; it explains their location through the collapse of two classical pinch values and the altered ramification of the normalizing double covers. The explicit arithmetic decomposition supplies context but is not used as sole value. The local Fitting data can inform normalization, conductor and deformation calculations.
